skill.name: resume-optimizer
skill.description: Helps optimize resumes by matching them to job descriptions, suggesting improvements, and predicting interview questions.
skill.summary: Improve resumes for specific job applications with targeted feedback.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

security_audit.summary: The static entropy heuristic flagged SKILL.md, but review showed a short plain Markdown skill description with front matter and Chinese text. No scripts, external network behavior, credential access, command execution, or prompt injection attempts were found in the available file.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.23 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is readable Markdown with YAML front matter, Chinese text, and no encoded or binary payload. The entropy score appears caused by Unicode content rather than obfuscation.

content.user_title: Optimize Resumes for Target Job Descriptions
content.value_statement: Job seekers often struggle to align resumes with specific openings. This skill compares resume content with job descriptions and suggests focused improvements.
actual_capabilities: Compares resume content with a target job description.
Suggests stronger wording for experience, skills, and achievements.
Identifies missing keywords and role requirements.
Predicts likely interview questions from resume and job description.
Reminds users to review important AI-generated output.
limitations: Requires user-provided resume and job description content.
Does not verify employment history, credentials, or facts.
Does not guarantee interviews, offers, or ATS ranking.
Contains high-level instructions only, without built-in templates or scripts.

use_cases.title: Tailor a Resume for an Opening
use_cases.description: Compare a resume against a target role and prioritize edits that improve relevance.

use_cases.title: Prepare Candidate Fit Notes
use_cases.description: Summarize how a candidate profile maps to job requirements before a screening call.

use_cases.title: Improve Freelance Pitch Materials
use_cases.description: Align project history with a client brief and prepare likely interview responses.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Resume Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my resume for clarity and impact. Identify the top five improvements and explain why each matters.

prompt_templates.title: Match Resume to a Job Description
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my resume with this job description. List strong matches, missing requirements, and suggested resume edits.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite Experience Bullets
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite my experience bullets for this role. Keep facts unchanged, improve action verbs, and highlight measurable results.

prompt_templates.title: Full Application Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my resume against the job description. Prioritize gaps, revise key sections, and predict likely interview questions.

output_examples.input: A product manager resume and a senior product manager job description.
output: Strong match: roadmap ownership and stakeholder communication.
Gap: add measurable launch outcomes and customer research examples.
Suggested edit: highlight cross-functional delivery in the summary.

output_examples.input: A marketing candidate's experience section for a growth marketing role.
output: Rewrite broad campaign statements with channel, budget, and conversion details.
Add keywords for lifecycle marketing, experimentation, and retention.
Move analytics tools into a dedicated skills section.

output_examples.input: A resume and job description before a technical interview.
output: Likely question: describe a project where you improved performance.
Likely question: explain how you handled changing requirements.
Prepare examples that connect listed skills to business results.

best_practices: Provide the full resume and the exact job description for better matching.
Verify every suggested edit before sending an application.
Keep factual achievements unchanged while improving structure and wording.
anti_patterns: Do not invent experience, credentials, dates, or metrics.
Do not paste sensitive personal data that is not needed for review.
Do not use one optimized resume for every job application.

faq.question: Does this skill rewrite an entire resume?
faq.answer: It can suggest rewrites and improvements, but users should review and approve all final wording.

faq.question: Can it match a resume to a job description?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed to compare resume content with job description requirements.

faq.question: Does it predict interview questions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can infer likely questions from the resume, role, and listed requirements.

faq.question: Will it guarantee an ATS score?
faq.answer: No. It can improve keyword alignment, but it cannot guarantee ATS ranking or employer decisions.

faq.question: Can recruiters use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. Recruiters can use it to prepare fit notes and screening questions.

faq.question: Is private resume data protected by the skill?
faq.answer: The skill does not include code for storage or transmission. Users should still avoid unnecessary sensitive data.
